title: What the Platypus belongs to

is_this_you.pressure: Cornered, you stay under for as long as your breath holds. Then the spur, quick, and you are gone downstream.
is_this_you.love: You want someone who believes what you felt before you could prove it.
is_this_you.cost: Three different crowds each think you are mostly theirs. You let them, and it wears you out.

opener.text: On the upper Darling River, people tell how the Ancestor Spirits set the totems, and the birds, the marsupials and the fish each asked the platypus to join [s5]. After talking with the echidna it turned all three down, because it shared something with each and wanted to stay friends with every one [s5]. The source does not name the nation who tells it, and WWF-Australia's writer calls the choice an act of diplomacy [s5]. You were born under Aquarius in a Pig year. Your refusals can look like indecision. Usually you decided long before anyone asked.

howto: Three parts, in no fixed order. Nothing about you came in order either.

tabs.label: Not one thing
tabs.intro: Air that will not be filed. Water that goes in with its eyes shut.

rows.text: Aquarius is fixed Air, original and loyal, and hard to read from outside [s1] [s2]. The Pig is yin Water, generous and calm in trouble, and very focused once it picks a goal [s3] [s4]. On paper you look odd. In practice you work. You can sit with three different crowds in one week and mean it with each.

The platypus is one of five living monotremes, the mammals that lay eggs [s8] [s19]. It has fur and a bill, and the mother has no nipples, so her milk seeps through her skin onto the fur [s8] [s12]. Every part seems borrowed from a different list, and the animal gets on with its life.

tabs.label: Under the water
tabs.intro: Eyes shut, ears shut, and still you find it.

rows.text: When it dives, the platypus closes its eyes, ears and nostrils tight [s10]. It hunts with its bill, which carries about 40,000 electroreceptors and about 60,000 touch receptors [s10]. You read people through channels nobody else counts. Explaining it afterward tires you more than the finding did.

A nesting burrow can run up to 30 metres [s12]. Along the tunnel the platypus packs plugs of soil, anywhere from two to nine of them [s13]. Your private life has plugs too. The people allowed past every one would fit at one small table.
The Pig keeps digging once the target is set [s4]. Add the bill and you suit work that catches a faint signal: diagnostics, sensor design, audit, investigation.

tabs.label: Who takes you as you are
tabs.intro: Three who will not ask you to pick one. One who pulls hard the other way.
tabs.love_lead: Aquarius in love asks for freedom and chooses by personality, come as you are [s2]. The Pig trusts with its whole heart, sometimes too easily [s3] [s4]. The old pairings point to three easy matches.

easy.why: The Luna Moth (Libra, Goat year) shares your trine of Rabbit, Goat and Pig, and Libra is the third Air sign [s3] [s1].
The Fennec Fox (Gemini, Rabbit year) is trine kin through the Rabbit, and Gemini breathes the same Air as you [s3] [s1].
The Maned Wolf (Aquarius, Tiger year) is your secret friend, since the Tiger is the Pig's hidden ally, and it shares your sign [s3].

hard.why: The Blue-ringed Octopus (Leo, Snake year) is the hard one: the Snake clashes with the Pig, and Leo sits opposite Aquarius [s3] [s1].

story.text: In 1799 the first platypus pelt reached George Shaw at the British Museum, and he doubted it was real [s8]. The suspicion was a duck's bill sewn onto a beaver-like body [s8]. History Today says Shaw went at it with scissors, trying to cut the beak off [s9]. The beak stayed on.

closing: Let the birds, the fish and the furred ones all keep a seat for you. You still go home to your own bank.
